text_block_list.text:
One day, Oguri Cap called me out to the 
dance studio.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: So you came...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I came up with choreography for the song 
in dance lesson, but the chorus just 
doesn't feel right.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I'm going to dance now, so 
please give me your honest thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: How did it go?
choice_data_list:
You're good, but it's missing that 
Oguri-like touch.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Being true to myself, huh... That might 
just be what was missing.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer. Now then, what should 
we do...
choice_data_list: Is there any choreography you like, Oguri?
Is there any choreography you like, Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. There is a dance called the 
"Basho Dance," you see.

Searching for "Basho Dance" on the phone 
brought up videos of people dancing in 
happi coats.
choice_data_list: Am I doing this dance right?
Am I doing this dance right?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's a dance performed during 
festivals in my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Listening to the festival music while 
watching them dance really gives me 
energy.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
It might have a different flavor from a 
Winning Live, but I truly love this dance.
choice_data_list: I think it'd be good to incorporate that.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I see...! Then please, show me the footage 
of the festival again.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Could you tell me what parts you thought 
were good, Trainer? I'd like to 
incorporate them if possible."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... Just watching her moves fills 
you with energy."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I think the movements after the drum 
beats are great, too. If we combine the 
two—"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Alright, all done. Now all that's left is 
to put it into practice.

Dancing to the completed choreography, 
Oguri Cap captivated the hearts of 
onlookers with her powerful movements.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed... Those moves simply steal your 
gaze."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"I think the movements after the drum 
beats are great, too. If we combine the 
two—"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Alright, all done. Now all that's left is 
to put it into practice.

Dancing to the completed choreography, 
Oguri Cap captivated the hearts of 
onlookers with her supple movements.
